purpose: Independent, offline analytical and full-pipeline evaluation of the bounded audited PGx surface; not clinical validation or clinical utility evaluation.

truth_source.name: CDC GeT-RM Consolidated PGx and HLA Table
truth_source.declared_scope: Up-to-date consensus PGx genotypes for 363 DNA samples characterized in nine GeT-RM PGx/HLA studies covering 34 genes/loci.
truth_source.integrity: Record SHA-256 and byte size immediately after download. The source table is immutable for this benchmark once cohort_lock.json is written.
prohibited_truth_derivation: No truth label may be taken from PharmCAT, this application, its mapping YAML, or its output.
No blank truth cell may be inferred as reference or normal.
No disagreement may be resolved by editing the truth table after outputs are examined.

genomic_source.name: 1000 Genomes Project 30x high-coverage GRCh38 phased SNV/INDEL/SV panel
genomic_source.input_characteristic: Polymorphic-filtered research VCF. Omitted positions are unknown, never inferred reference.
genomic_source.integrity: Use source-indexed remote slices without genotype rewriting; record each source URL, extraction regions, SHA-256, and byte size.

software_lock.application_source: Current local working tree after Phases 1-3; record candidate artifact hash and Git revision in benchmark_manifest.json before evaluation.
software_lock.production_changes_during_benchmark: Forbidden. A newly demonstrated production defect is documented and evaluation stops before any fix.

cohort_locking.sample_rule: Include every sample identifier present in both the frozen CDC truth workbook and the frozen 1000 Genomes 3,202-sample manifest. Do not subsample or select by expected result.
cohort_locking.why_ids_are_resolved_after_acquisition: The authoritative consolidated workbook is the source of sample identity. The exact deterministic intersection is written to cohort_lock.json and the sample-by-gene truth table before any PharmCAT or application output is run or inspected.
cohort_locking.post_lock_changes: No sample or truth row may be removed. Later failures remain in the exclusion/discrepancy logs with a reason.

genes.rule: A primary gene is evaluated only when the consolidated table has an explicit consensus diplotype/genotype interpretable without consulting application output. CYP2D6 is reported separately as a predeclared abstention control and is never pooled with callable-gene accuracy.

inclusion_criteria: Sample is in the deterministic GeT-RM/1000 Genomes intersection.
Truth cell explicitly contains a consensus genotype or diplotype for the gene.
The truth value is not blank, pending, failed, discordant, or explicitly unresolved.
Genomic evidence is downloadable from the frozen 1000 Genomes release and passes file-integrity validation.
The sample remains single-sample when presented to the application.
input_contract: GT is parsed by FORMAT key and is complete for a position to count.
Partial/no-call and failed FILTER evidence are not valid complete observations.
Every required gene dependency is evaluated using the shared application eligibility logic.
Missing genomic positions remain absent/unknown and are never synthesized as reference.
No DP/GQ threshold is invented; quality-not-established follows the documented application policy.

equivalence_rules.exact_diplotype: Compare unordered allele pairs after trimming whitespace and normalizing only allele order. Preserve gene prefixes, suballeles, copy-number notation, tandem/hybrid notation, and bracketed compound alleles; do not collapse them.
equivalence_rules.candidate_compatible: Compatible only when the independently characterized truth diplotype is an exact member of the application's preserved candidate set after the same order-only normalization. This does not count as exact concordance.
equivalence_rules.phenotype: Score only when the independent truth resource explicitly supplies a phenotype/functional state or a separately frozen authoritative mapping supplies it. Never derive phenotype truth from PharmCAT or application output.
equivalence_rules.unparseable: Retain the row and classify it truth_nomenclature_not_safely_parseable; do not force equivalence.

actionable_state.definition: A truth state is actionable only when a separately frozen authoritative CPIC context maps the independent truth diplotype/phenotype to a recommendation to change dose, choose an alternative, or otherwise alter therapy. Unknown, missing, or unmapped truth is not silently classified as non-actionable.
actionable_state.freeze_rule: The truth-to-actionability table must be written and hashed before application final results are evaluated.
actionable_state.non_actionable: Explicit authoritative no-change recommendation for the independent truth state.
actionable_state.unavailable: If independent phenotype/context is insufficient, false-reassurance and false-warning denominators are reported as zero/not estimable rather than inferred.

layers.A_upstream: Compare PharmCAT source diplotype/candidates and phenotype, before application evidence gating or risk mapping, with independent truth.
layers.B_application: Run the unchanged shared evidence/dependency eligibility and final result construction. Compare assertion/abstention and, where independently evaluable, final action state with truth.

abstention_policy.upstream_no_call: Not concordant; counted as upstream abstention, never as an incorrect asserted genotype.
abstention_policy.application_unknown: Counted as application abstention. It lowers assertion coverage but is not a false reassurance or false warning.
abstention_policy.candidate_set: Counted as an assertion only for candidate-compatible coverage, not exact-diplotype assertion coverage.
abstention_policy.cyp2d6: Expected application abstention and reported separately; never credited as callable-gene accuracy.

metrics.unit: Unique individuals within each gene. Repeated genes in one individual are never treated as independent observations in a pooled confidence interval.
per_gene: exact diplotype concordance / all evaluable truth rows
candidate-compatible concordance / all evaluable truth rows
phenotype concordance / rows with independent phenotype truth
assertion coverage / all evaluable truth rows
conditional exact accuracy / exact diplotype assertions
metrics.intervals: Two-sided 95% Wilson intervals only for per-gene binomial proportions with at least five independent individuals and a meaningful numerator/denominator. Smaller denominators are reported as counts without an interval. No pooled marketing accuracy is computed.
metrics.aggregation: Report each gene separately. A descriptive macro average may be shown only with every per-gene denominator beside it and no confidence interval.

stopping_rules: Do not modify production behavior after viewing results.
If a production correctness defect is demonstrated, document it and stop before fixing it.
Do not tune equivalence, eligibility, or actionability definitions on evaluated output.
Negative or sparse findings remain in the final report.
